A leading and dynamic organization in the Central District is looking for a Data & Power BI Analyst to lead end-to-end BI processes and transform complex business data into actionable, data-driven insights.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyze business requirements and translate them into BI solutions.

Integrate and consolidate data from multiple sources.

Build and maintain advanced data models.

Develop dashboards and management reports using Power BI.

Define KPIs and business performance metrics.

Perform data quality checks and validations.

Manage user permissions and optimize system performance.

Requirements:

At least 1 year of hands-on experience as a BI Analyst using Power BI – Required.

Strong knowledge of DAX and Power Query – Required.

Experience working with SQL and Data Modeling – Required.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent organizational abilities and the ability to work independently.
